title: Another Day, Relaxed and Full of Energy

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Satisfied, satisfied, super satisfied~! Mufufu~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While I was finishing up some paperwork before training,
Machikane Tannhauser walked in in high spirits.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yup yup! I got rainbow gummies, dried scallop rims,
and um, let's see... the eighth Lucky God, Tokoroten!!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Eheheh♪ Like I said, I enjoyed octopuses, scallops,
and the eighth Lucky God~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I didn't quite follow, so I decided
to ask for the full story.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Well, first off, Turbo said she wanted rainbow octopus gummies,
so we hit the convenience store together!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: And we got our hands on a multi-colored pack of octopus gummies. But!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
When we took a close look at the package, a little octopus speech bubble said,
"Contains ultra-rare crab gummies!"—

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So after that, we just kept scarfing down octopuses! We kept at it till
we finally found two whole crabs and split them up happily♪

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And next, I bought some dried scallop rims with Nature at the shopping district,
and then it was munch-munch tea time!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Man, this lady we bumped into at the shopping street brewed us some tea,
and let me tell you, it paired so amazingly well with the scallops!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Plus, Nature was super sweet.
She even let me have the very last, precious piece!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I chewed thoughtfully on that scallop rim... contemplating life,
and just basked in its deep, rich flavor~.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And last of all, I went fortune hunting with Fuku-chan-senpai! Over hill and dale,
we finally arrived at our destination, and there—

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
We finally found it!
Standing right alongside Daikokuten and Ebisu—the eighth Lucky God, Tokoroten!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
According to Fuku-chan-senpai, this fact hasn't been made public yet,
so we're the only ones who know about it.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Finding such a legendary existence made both of us so deeply moved...!
We offered our prayers and enjoyed eating it deliciously~♪

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Man, oh man~ I'm really so glad everyone's such good friends with me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...It sounded like a much more intense day than I'd imagined.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Besides, that's an awful lot to cram into a single day.
Most people would be completely exhausted, but...

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Not tired at all~! It was all right around the neighborhood,
so I'm totally full of energy! See, look how light on my feet I am!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as she said, she showed no signs of physical or mental fatigue.
If anything, she looked even more vibrant and energetic than usual.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, barring anything truly extraordinary,
she always seemed to be full of pep.
choice_data_list: You really are full of energy.
You really have boundless energy, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
You think so? It feels pretty normal to me.
Still, hearing you say that makes me kinda happy. Ehehe♪

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Trainer, do you want some octopus gummies too?
I still have plenty left over.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, huh? Where did I put them?
Ooo-ee, octopus, come on out~! Mr. Occc-to-pusss——

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*CLOOOOONK!!*)

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*RUMBLE CRASH CRATTER!!*)

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hwah-yaaaah!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Machikane Tannhauser slammed straight into the table,
spectacularly sending the bag of gummies on top flying everywhere...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: What's more, the impact with the table had given her a nosebleed...!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ow-ow-ow, I did id agaid... *sniiifflle*.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, id's totally nodmal for me.
I'm good as new~. *sniiiiiifflle*.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
—Ah! But the bagged octopuses!
I'm sorryyy, I'm coming to save you right nooowww...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Machikane Tannhauser was so cheerful and lively it could make you worry at times.
I silently resolved to keep a close eye on her as best I could...
